comment: Blocked independent monster-to-monster potion intercept attempt. Four hostile gnome kings are generated, then the hero moves west to try to place a second monster in the remembered target line. The C trace showed the nearby gnome kings closing and taking their adjacent melee attacks instead; monmove.c:m_move() suppresses find_offensive() on the nearby branch, so mthrowu.c:m_throw() -> ohitmon(POTION_CLASS) was never reached. Keep this recipe as a setup blocker, not matching evidence.
